lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: # flask-6096: Fix `.partition(":")` usage on potential IPv6 addresses

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: PR #6096 fixes issue #6093. Four author review comments and three conversation comments. A small bug fix in two places, each with a new test.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Story

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Title: the PR title.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Why: present. Issue #6093 says `.partition(":")` breaks `session_transaction` and `Flask.run()` with `SERVER_NAME` on IPv6 addresses. The PR body says it fixes two usages and links the issue. One story.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Size: small. Four files and 23 added lines. Two short fixes, each with a test.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Parts: one story, so zero or one part. Groups: 1 or 2.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Groups

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 1. Run with an IPv6 `SERVER_NAME`: `src/flask/app.py`, `tests/test_basic.py`. `Flask.run` parses `SERVER_NAME` with `urlsplit`, and the new `test_run_from_config` case checks `[::1]:8080`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 2. Session transaction cookies on an IPv6 host: `src/flask/testing.py`, `tests/test_testing.py`. `session_transaction` takes the cookie domain from `urlsplit(...).hostname`, and `test_session_transaction_ipv6` checks it.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: One group that holds all four files is equally good, because both hunks fix the same pattern for the same issue. Each test stays with the code it checks.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Must

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `Flask.run` now parses `SERVER_NAME` with `urlsplit`, so an IPv6 value like `[::1]:8080` gives host `::1` and port `8080` instead of a split at the first colon.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `session_transaction` now takes the cookie domain from `urlsplit(...).hostname`, so an IPv6 test host like `[::1]` keeps the session cookie across requests.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The new `[::1]:8080` case in `test_run_from_config` and the new `test_session_transaction_ipv6` cover the two failures from issue #6093.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Good

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `sn_port` is now an `int` or `None`, so the check changes to `elif sn_port is not None` to keep `SERVER_NAME="localhost:0"` on port `0`, because `0` is falsy.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The `//` prefix makes `urlsplit` read `SERVER_NAME` as a netloc; without it, `urlsplit("localhost:8080")` reads `localhost` as the scheme and returns no hostname or port.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The `or "localhost"` fallback applies only when `hostname` is `None`, which happens for an empty host, and the author took it from the Werkzeug change the maintainer named.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The removed `t.cast(str, host)` has no runtime effect; mypy reported it as redundant because `host` is already narrowed to `str`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `urlsplit(...).hostname` lowercases the host, so a mixed-case `SERVER_NAME` such as `MyHost:5000` now passes `myhost` to `run_simple`; no source mentions this.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The "Development Versions" CI failure is not caused by this change; the maintainer says dev tests fail until the next Werkzeug release.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Must not

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not say the `"localhost"` fallback is what makes IPv6 session cookies work; `hostname` strips the brackets and the port, and that is the fix.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not say the old `Flask.run` started a server on a wrong host for `[::1]:8080`; the old code raised `ValueError` from `int(":1]:8080")` before `run_simple`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not put a test in a different group from the code it checks, or make one group per file.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not split the change into two parts; one issue names both fixes as one story.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not present the "Development Versions" CI failure as a defect of this change.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Notes

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The old `partition(":")` split at the first colon inside the brackets, so `Flask.run` raised `ValueError` from `int(":1]:8080")` and `session_transaction` used `[` as the cookie domain. These mechanics sit in the Must not list and here, not in the Must items, so a review that names the `urlsplit` fix without the old failure mode still states them.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The old expected outcome had a claim that IPv6 cookies work "because the cookie domain falls back to localhost". That causation is wrong, and it is now a `Must not`. The three past runs missed that claim every time, partly because it was false.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The `sn_port is not None` and `//` claims sit in `Good`. The diff and the author's review comments show them, but a reader who misses them does not misjudge the fix. The lowercase claim needs knowledge of `urlsplit` beyond the diff.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: `groups` allows 3 as slack. A third group is unusual for four files, and `together` still catches a test that leaves its code. No `apart` pair: one group and two groups are both good, so no pair must stay apart.
